{{Quote|Follow the Triellus Trade Route until you reach the 5709-DC Shipping Lane, then bear 47° to starboard, set your beacon finder on frequency TG69-75, and ride our beam all the way here!|[[Tatooine Visitors Bureau]] brochure|<ref name="SWTJ" />}}
The '''Triellus Trade Route''', sometimes nicknamed the '''"Hutt Highway"''', was the most notable [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] trade route of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]] with the area in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] near [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==Course==
Beginning in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and dipping rimward of Hutt Space before emerging the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] in the Mid Rim, it spanned more than 75000 [[Light-year/Legends|light-years]].<ref name="TEA" />

Due to its proximity to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], it was named the '''"Hutt Highway"'''.<ref name="TEA" /> One of the larger spurs of the route was the [[5709-DC Shipping Lane]]. It informally split the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].

It consisted one of the three sides of the infamous [[Spice Triangle/Legends|Spice Triangle]] (with the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] and the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]).<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
Travel times along it were slow, plagued by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and other criminals who made their career. Although it had the benefit of avoiding the Hutt Space, trivel times were slower,<ref name="TEA" /> and usually it was avoided by lawful [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].

In [[137 ABY]], [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Dovrin]] hijacked an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] shipping vessel in the [[5709-DC Shipping Lane]].<ref name="swl37tp1">[[Legacy (2006) 37|''Legacy'' (2006) 37]]</ref>
